mechanism: Sumatriptan causes coronary vasoconstriction and tachycardia which may counteract ivabradine's heart rate-lowering effects, while ivabradine may mask compensatory tachycardia from sumatriptan's vasoconstrictive effects.
action: Use combination cautiously in patients with coronary artery disease or significant cardiac risk factors; monitor heart rate and blood pressure; consider alternative migraine therapy in high-risk patients.
